agent_cloud.title: Move agent to the cloud
agent_cloud.active: The VPS owns this agent. Chat and routines continue there while this PC is off.
agent_cloud.pending: Handoff is not yet confirmed. Local execution stays paused to prevent duplicate work.
agent_cloud.load_failed: Could not load cloud ownership or servers.
agent_cloud.description: Move this agent's conversation, memory, workspace and scheduled routines to your VPS. Continue using its chat from this PC.
agent_cloud.requirements: Supports idle Jarvis agents using a subscription CLI and recurring time-based routines. The VPS needs Jarvis, tmux and its own subscription login. API models, one-shot routines and cross-machine team workflows are not supported yet. Desktop dependencies must be resolved first.
agent_cloud.credentials: Uses the model login already configured on the VPS. Passwords, local logins and browser profiles are not copied.
